from mailman.config import config
from mailman.database.pruning import Database
from mailman.model.mailinglist import MailingList
from mailman.model.member import Member
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

# Connect to the database
db_path = config.Database.path
print(f"Database path: {db_path}")

# Query the database
engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{db_path}")
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
session = Session()

# Query all mailing lists
lists = session.query(MailingList).all()
for lst in lists:
    print(f"\nList: {lst.list_id} ({lst.fqdn_listname})")
    print(f"  Subscription policy: {lst.subscription_policy}")
    
    # Query members
    members = session.query(Member).filter(Member.mailing_list == lst).all()
    for member in members:
        print(f"  Member: {member.address.email} ({member.role})")

session.close()
EOF
